Gate changes to transmission mode, inhibit/event units, ranges and zero behavior separately for RPDO and TPDO; unchanged settings do not require every timer or SYNC capability. Qualify producer transition and queued RX/TX retirement, distinct route or observable marker before qualifying samples; that separate gate does not prevent confirmation of map contents.
